content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

When it comes to processing international payments, freelancers in Bangladesh have a few options. One popular choice is Binance P2P, which supports a range of currencies including naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. However, this platform requires users to have a Binance account and can be prone to high fees. Another option is NOWPayments, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-honest-side-side|Crypto Payments]]currency payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and offers a flat fee of 0.5%. This option is particularly attractive to freelancers who want to offer their customers a wide range of payment options. By integrating NOWPayments into their digital commerce stack, Bangladeshi freelancers can accept international payments with ease and speed.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Binance P2P and NOWPayments handle them differently. Binance P2P has a more restrictive policy, limiting access to certain countries and requiring users to have a verified account. In contrast, NOWPayments takes a more inclusive approach, allowing users to accept payments from any country without the need for a verified account or complex setup. This makes NOWPayments a more attractive option for freelancers who want to expand their customer base globally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

In terms of payment speed, USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This makes it an attractive option for freelancers who want to receive payments quickly and efficiently. However, the fees associated with Binance P2P can be steep, ranging from 0.5% to 1.5% depending on the currency and payment method. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a flat fee of 0.5%, making it a more cost-effective option for freelancers who want to accept international payments.
With NOWPayments, Bangladeshi freelancers can accept international payments quickly and efficiently.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, NOWPayments offers a range of benefits. By integrating NOWPayments into their digital commerce stack, freelancers can automate their payment processing, reducing the risk of errors and increasing the speed of delivery. Additionally, NOWPayments allows users to retain full ownership of their payments, making it a more secure option for freelancers who want to protect their revenue streams.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between Binance P2P and NOWPayments depends on the specific needs of the freelancer. If they need to accept payments from a wide range of currencies and want to offer their customers a wide range of payment options, NOWPayments may be the better choice. However, if they are looking for a more traditional payment gateway with a lower fee structure, Binance P2P may be a better option.
